_note: Edit dates here if life happens. A task counts as done when its 'done_when' path exists in the repo. Sessions are the evenings you sit down for 45 minutes.

tasks.title: Build the blog section (with Claude)
tasks.why: Every post after this has a home. This is the foundation.
tasks.first_step: Open Claude and say: "Let's build the blog section." That's the whole first step.

tasks.title: Post 1: Phaser 4 texture atlas (test the demo on your phone, then publish)
tasks.why: Indie devs search for this every day. They're your buyers.
tasks.first_step: Open the live demo on your phone (tekisolves.github.io/assets/blog/phaser-4-texture-atlas/demo/). Aim, fire, swap tiers. Then read the draft and change anything that doesn't sound like you.

tasks.title: Post 2: Weapon tier upgrades in Godot 4
tasks.why: Godot is where indie devs are moving. Be there when they search.
tasks.first_step: Make one Godot scene that swaps a tier 1 sprite for tier 2 on a key press.

tasks.title: Post 3: Free sci-fi weapon sprites (sample pack)
tasks.why: Give first. A free sample is the best salesperson a shy founder can have.
tasks.first_step: Pick the 3 sprites you're proudest of. Just pick them.

tasks.title: Post 4: Devlog, how I made Retro Arsenal
tasks.why: Your story is the one thing nobody can copy.
tasks.first_step: Write 5 bullet points on how it was made. Ugly is fine.

tasks.title: Monthly refresh: check Search Console, improve one post
tasks.why: Google shows you what people want. Give them more of it.
tasks.first_step: Open Search Console > Performance. Copy the top 10 queries to Claude.

tasks.title: Monthly refresh: check Search Console, plan the next post
